sources.summary: The Royal Institute of British Architects has announced 32 winners of the National Awards 2026, with the majority located in London. Featured among the 32 winners announced by the Royal Institute of British Architects (RIBA) are a rammed-earth house, a London university campus and a cottage in the Scottish Highlands.
